originality.rationale: The specific homotopy claim is absent from the inspected primary texts on transversals and Latin square clique homology. value.rationale: The cyclic order-six group table is the first classical nontrivial even composite cyclic transversal obstruction. The complete mixed-dimensional homotopy type of its natural rainbow-matching complex records lower 2-homology and higher 3-homology not determined by transversal counts, maximum partial transversal size, or the clique homology of the opposite graph. The exact 14/75 decomposition is a meaningful invariant for comparing order-six squares and developing topological matching bounds, not an arbitrary induced slice.
